$description: Tier 3 · Component knobs for the leaf controls (packages/ui: progress.tsx, float-button.tsx). Merged with component.json at build and emitted as --c-*. Every top-level name here is new, so no key collides with component.json however the two are merged. The controls' own sizes (Button 40 / 32, Switch 44 × 24 with a 16 knob, Checkbox 16, Badge and Kbd 20, a skeleton row's 12px bars 20px apart) sit on the 4px spacing scale and the size roles, so they need no knob.

progress-track.$description: Progress: the empty part of a bar, and an empty cell of a segmented one. Figma binds the empty part to line/rule (List Row progress, segments 20 to 32). Beside the other Progress knobs in component.json (height 4px, segment-gap 2px, fill, complete, warning, over).

progress-tone.$description: Progress fills beyond the ones in `progress` (fill, complete, warning, over). Each fill is drawn on --c-progress-track (scripts/recipes/controls.mjs).

live.$description: Live or agent activity: a segmented bar's default fill, and tone="live" on either variant. Figma: List Row progress, segments 1 to 19.

critical.$description: tone="critical": a countdown that is about to run out. Figma (Lockdown codes): the ticks near expiry.

float-button.$description: FloatButton's long press (onLongPress). Behaviour timers, not motion: the component reads them when a press starts, and falls back to these same values without the stylesheet.

long-press-delay.$description: How long a press is held before it counts as a long press.

long-press-slop.$description: How far the pointer may drift during the hold before the long press is called off.
